description: Prompt-set construction recipes for the reported evaluations. The prompt texts are not redistributed; they are selected deterministically from the named public dataset with the recorded seed, so the same collections can be rebuilt.

prompt_source.license: see the dataset card on Hugging Face

negative_calibration_sd21.purpose: Clean (non-watermarked) scores for Score threshold calibration at FPR = 1%.
negative_calibration_sd21.seeds: sequential integers per prompt, starting at 0
negative_calibration_sd21.note: Each clean image is paired with watermark metadata in the evaluation manifest, so the recorded score is a false-positive score.

quality_prompts_sd21_100.purpose: Matched clean/watermarked pairs for BRISQUE, KID and CLIP comparison.
quality_prompts_sd21_100.seeds: one 32-bit seed per prompt, drawn with the recorded prompts_seed

procedure: Load the dataset split and apply the recorded prompt filter.
Select prompt_count prompts deterministically using prompts_seed.
Generate images with the recorded model, guidance scale and seeds (scripts/generate_quality_images.py for image-only collections, the main CLI when metadata and receipts are needed).
Score with scripts/eval_attack_manifest.py under the inversion settings recorded in the threshold file.
note: The frozen thresholds at the repository root are preserved constants from the reported evaluation; their original negative collections are not redistributed, so a fresh calibration will not reproduce those exact values.
